newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB 13wk bill gross yield steady at 12.20pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB 13wk bill gross yield steady at 12.20pct.

text.p: Gross yield in Wednesday's Czech National Bank (CNB) auction of a five billion crown tranche of 13-week liquidity bills was 12.20 percent, unchanged from the last auction of similar paper on April 24.
The CNB said in a statement the issue was undersubscribed, with bids totalling 4.301 billion crowns.
Net yield was 9.15 percent, it added.
The three-month Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 12.24 percent on Wednesday, up slightly from 12.23 percent on Tuesday.
